A '''water tower''' was a large tank that stored a supply of [[Water/Legends|water]].

A water tower in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] existed to replenish the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]' water supply. The tower could be hooked up to a [[firehose]] and used to put out potentially deadly fires within the village, and was once used in tandem with the firehose to extinguish a fire which had been formed by the [[Stranger]] using the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]].
